finding_rulings.reason: All four reviewers (adversarial, correctness, red-team, alternative-approach) returned unusable output, so the board has zero review coverage. A DEGRADED board with no surviving lane gives no evidence on correctness, safety, or design. Deferring this would let the phase advance unreviewed. This is an infrastructure failure, not a code defect, but it still blocks: the gate cannot pass without at least one valid review.

forcing_decision: Halt phase advancement. Diagnose why all four lanes failed (likely causes are a shared cause such as malformed input or framing, a timeout or token limit, or a provider or auth outage), fix it, and re-run the full board. Proceed only once at least the correctness lane returns a usable review. If a re-run still degrades, escalate to a human reviewer rather than waiving the gate.
